label: Vans of fertiliser parked near Trump towers in New York
description: Vans carrying barrels of fertiliser, smaller than the drums in the dump truck he saw earlier, parked in New York City garages and beside buildings so as not to look suspicious, positioned as close as possible to Trump towers and locations, with the same attempted against landmarks in Washington.
aliases: Vans with the barrels full of fertilizer
as close as they could to Trump
parking them in New York City

label: A thousand men through tunnels, retaliating for Soleimani
description: A thousand men brought in through dark underground tunnels and divided into ten groups of a hundred, one per city, retaliating for the killing of Qasem Soleimani which he says they have not forgotten. He states this is not terrorism as such but an act of war by a government.
aliases: a thousand men that came through tunnels

label: New Orleans darkest but one man; Nashville and Las Vegas the mass plans
description: Three cities weighed against each other: New Orleans described as the darkest but with only one individual, Nashville and Las Vegas as the stronger and more intense, with mass plans and many people. He says there are more than these two and that he has been given a glimpse of only two.
aliases: there's more than just these two

label: London Bridge is falling down, sung over England
description: Given in tongues and interpretation over France, the Eiffel Tower and England: the nursery rhyme London Bridge is falling down, with a call for all hidden things in London to be revealed.
aliases: all hidden things be revealed in London
